text:
I'm sorry, that's a stressful thing to happen right before a move. Unfortunately I can't redirect it.

- **Redirecting:** Once an order has shipped, the shipping address can't be changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy. Shipped orders also can't be cancelled.
- **Express:** Express isn't available for island or remote addresses (Zone 3). Those orders ship Standard only, which takes 5-8 business days. Express also only applies to a new order, not one already on its way.

**What you can do**
- **Receive it at your old address:** Since you're moving next week, check the tracking email for the delivery estimate and see whether someone can collect it before you go.
- **Send a new order to your dad:** This is a separate, new order, so it would be charged separately. Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so an order placed now would ship Monday. Standard shipping is $7.95, or free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax). Live plants can't go to PO boxes, and if forecasts are below 35°F or above 95°F in transit, they may be held up to 7 days.

My policy information doesn't cover returning or rerouting a package that has already shipped to the wrong address, or whether the cost of the original order can be recovered. If you'd like, I can escalate this to a Support Lead to review your options. If you want me to do that, please send the order number (it looks like LF-123456) and tell me whether the wrong address was entered at checkout or whether it was a Leafy error.
